subject.title: fix: keep isolated gateway workspaces and skills inside state dir

question: Should this compatibility-sensitive change to non-default state-directory workspace and personal-skill behavior be accepted after live proof confirms both isolated and default-state outcomes?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label requires explicit maintainer handling, and the patch deliberately changes persisted defaults and runtime discovery for existing non-default state installations.

options.title: Confirm isolation contract and land
options.body: Accept the patch after reviewing redacted live proof that isolated state directories use `<state-dir>/workspace`, exclude home personal skills, and preserve the default-state behavior.

options.title: Narrow or defer the behavior change
options.body: Pause the PR if maintainers want non-default state roots to retain home personal skills or need a different migration and compatibility policy.

recommendation.title: Confirm isolation contract and land
recommendation.body: Accept the patch after reviewing redacted live proof that isolated state directories use `<state-dir>/workspace`, exclude home personal skills, and preserve the default-state behavior.
